ins_privacy: All computed in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
subtitle: Advanced tools to merge, extract, and clean your library.
main_file_desc: Choose the primary file you want to keep and add things into. (Required)
add_more_desc: Select files to merge into your Main Backup.
file_checker_desc: We instantly scanned your files. Click the Eye icon to peek inside or export notes.
extract_desc: Extract specific tags or dates into a new file.
color_desc: Change all old colors to a new color in one click.
manage_tags_desc: Click to expand, rename, and merge tags together.
auto_tag_desc: Instantly attach a tag to everything brought over from the secondary file (e.g. 'From Old iPad').
quick_sync_desc: Only bring over new notes created after a specific date.
deep_clean_desc: Sweeps away ghost data to make your app run faster.
conflict_title: If you edited a note on BOTH devices:
conflict_newest: Smart: Keep whichever version was saved most recently
conflict_base: Safe: Always keep the version from my 'Main Backup' file
important_desc: Ensure the JW Library app is updated to the latest version on all your devices before restoring this file.
recovery: Accidentally deleted your original backup? Recover it here.
faq_a1: Yes. Everything runs entirely inside your browser. No files are ever uploaded to any server. Your notes never leave your device.
faq_a2: No. The tool always works on a copy of your data in memory. Your original .jwlibrary file on your device is never modified.
faq_q3: Why does my merged file show 0 notes added?
faq_a3: This usually means all notes from the secondary file already exist in your main file. Try disabling 'Skip Exact Duplicates' if you believe notes are being wrongly skipped.
faq_q4: What if I have notes on both devices with the same content but different edits?
faq_a4: Use the 'Smart: Keep whichever version was saved most recently' conflict setting. This keeps the newest edit of any note that appears in both backups.
faq_q5: Can I merge more than two files?
faq_a5: Yes! Add as many secondary files as you like in Step 2. They are all merged into your main file one by one.
tip_1_body: Before merging, make sure JW Library is updated to the same version on all your devices. Mismatched versions can cause restore issues.
tip_2_body: Turn on 'Auto-Tag Imports' and give it a name like 'From Old iPad'. This tags everything you bring over so you can find or delete it easily later.
tip_3_title: Extract to share a study notebook
tip_3_body: Use 'Extract & Share' to create a smaller backup containing only notes with a specific tag — perfect for sharing a study outline with someone else.
tip_4_body: Deep Clean removes orphaned data. Run it after a large merge to keep your file lean, but you don't need to run it every time.
guide_step1_title: Create a Backup in JW Library
guide_step1_body: Open the JW Library app on your device. Go to the Personal Study tab, tap the Backup icon (cloud/arrows), then tap Create a Backup. Save the .jwlibrary file to your device storage.
guide_step2_body: Drop your primary backup into Step 1 (Main Backup). If merging from another device such as an iPad, add that backup in Step 2. You can add as many secondary files as you like.
guide_step3_body: Choose what to bring over: Notes, Highlights, or Bookmarks. Use the Tag Manager to rename messy tags. Enable Auto-Tag Imports to label everything from secondary files. Then click Merge.
guide_step4_body: Download your new .jwlibrary file. Open JW Library, go back to Backup, and tap Restore a Backup. Select your downloaded file. Your notes and highlights will appear.
hero_title: Merge JW Library backups privately in your browser
hero_desc: Studied on your phone and your tablet? Restoring either backup deletes the other's notes — merging is the only way to keep both. Then organise, search and share the library you already have, entirely in your browser.
err_corrupt: This file isn't a readable .jwlibrary backup — it may be corrupted or the wrong type of file.
err_no_db: This backup is missing its notes database (userData.db). Re-export the backup from JW Library and try again.
err_not_sqlite: The backup's database couldn't be opened — the file may be damaged.
err_oversize: This file is very large and may have run out of memory. Try closing other tabs and merging fewer files at once.
warn_oversize: These files are large — merging may take a little longer. Please keep this tab open.
feat_local_desc: All merging happens in your browser via WebAssembly. No server. No uploads. Complete privacy.
feat_tags_desc: Rename a tag across 300 notes, merge duplicates, bulk retag and recolour. JW Library has no bulk editing at all.
feat_date_desc: Pull out a service year, a convention or one study project as its own backup, without disturbing your main library.
feat_browse_desc: Search your whole library by keyword — or by meaning, describing the note you only half remember. Edit, retag and recolour, then download the updated backup.
feat_review_desc: See exactly which notes were edited on more than one device and choose which version wins — no black box.
footer_tagline: JW Sync processes all data locally — your files never leave your device.
app_subtitle: Follow the steps below. It only takes a minute!
disc_what: What else can JW Sync do?
disc_tag_desc: Rename or merge duplicate tags across all files
disc_extract_desc: Create a shareable file with just selected notes
disc_color_desc: Update all highlight colors in one click
disc_clean_desc: Remove leftover ghost data after merging
